hypotheses.hypothesis: Readable/compact relation surface syntax can remain independent of one deterministic typed canonical Relation IR identity.
hypotheses.mechanism: Parse each admitted surface into a declared RelationId and typed operands, then canonicalize before semantic hashing.
hypotheses.prediction: Semantically equivalent declared-bare, lexically-disjoint-sigil and generic-call forms produce byte-identical canonical IR and semantic_hash.
hypotheses.observed: 4/4 matched semantic cases produced identical hashes across all three candidate surfaces; @ref operand identity was preserved in 3/3 surfaces.
hypotheses.counterhypothesis: Full G9 context, precedence, dialect interactions or richer arities expose surface-dependent AST differences not present in this micro-oracle.
hypotheses.falsifier: A production-bound full-corpus N/S/D run in which intended-equivalent sources lower to unequal typed IR/semantic_hash, or a malformed/ambiguous source is silently admitted.

hypotheses.hypothesis: Relation-name resolution can be mechanically separated from execution authority.
hypotheses.mechanism: Canonical Relation nodes carry semantic relation identity and explicit authority=NONE; capability/effect authority remains external.
hypotheses.prediction: Unknown relation names fail closed without creating semantic or effect authority.
hypotheses.observed: Unknown relation mutation rejected in all 3 candidate surfaces; no candidate generated authority state.
hypotheses.counterhypothesis: Later compiler stages accidentally infer capability/effect authority from relation identity despite the parser/IR boundary.
hypotheses.falsifier: A type/effect/lowering test where a RelationId alone authorizes or commits an external effect.

hypotheses.hypothesis: One of strict normalization/declared relation/disjoint compact/generic forms will dominate after production full-corpus cost and correctness measurement.
hypotheses.prediction: Matched production-parser measurements separate candidates on diagnostics, migration cost, reader repair, token/context cost, complexity and latency while preserving one typed IR oracle.
hypotheses.counterhypothesis: No single surface dominates and ClayCode should support a generic canonical form plus restricted verified sugar/projections.
hypotheses.falsifier: Matched evidence shows a stable Pareto frontier without a justified single winner.
